target.title: fix: make bridge rpc text sends idempotent
target.body:
## Summary

- assign every bridge-backed JSON-RPC text send a stable per-request message GUID
- pin that GUID through every IMMessage construction path
- generate a helper-side GUID fallback so `send.rich`, CLI rich sends, and other bridge text callers share the same duplicate-commit protection
- add focused regression coverage and a 0.12.3 changelog entry

Refs #158.

## Why

The reported failure produces two physical rows with distinct GUIDs from one logical bridge send. Pinning one GUID before IMCore sees the message makes duplicate internal commits converge on the same message identity instead of materializing as two outbound messages.

## Verification

- rebased onto current `main`
- `make test` — 376 tests passed
- `make lint` — passed; existing warnings only, 0 serious violations
- `make build` — universal CLI and helper built successfully, including arm64e helper
- Codex autoreview — clean, no accepted/actionable findings before the rebase; the rebase conflict was changelog-only

## Live validation gate

Not merge-ready yet. The available test host has SIP enabled and reports `v2_ready: false`, so the physical-delivery reproduction cannot run there without weakening the requested proof.

@lowcode-garage could you please run the issue's fresh-process probe against this branch on the reproducing SIP-disabled Mac, for both direct `to` and `chat_guid` sends, and report request count, response count, outbound row count, unique GUID count, and any duplicated probe texts? Once that shows one physical row per request, this can land.
